title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.32540v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion dr

translated_title: 基于纯净锚点的在飞KV缓存以加速自回归视频扩散
translated_abstract: 少步自回归视频扩散通过将长视频划分为时间块并逐块生成来生成长视频，每一块经由一段较短的去噪阶段序列完成。为了记住已生成的块，先前的方法需要通过额外的前向计算来重建干净或低噪声的键值（KV）缓存，在不推进输出潜变量的情况下构建缓存。然而，每一次去噪前向计算本身其实已经在计算当前块的“在飞”KV。我们提出FlashForward，直接复用这一缓存，从而避免繁重的仅用于更新缓存的模型前向计算。当当前块完成一个去噪阶段后，其该阶段专属的缓存即可供下一个块使用。因此，若为每个阶段分配一块GPU，就可以让不同的块并发地处于不同的去噪阶段。这种提前可用性带来了质量代价：所得到的与阶段匹配的历史是有噪声的，会导致外观与运动的漂移。
tldr: FlashForward通过直接复用去噪前向计算中已经产生的“在飞”KV缓存（并以纯净锚点弥补带噪历史带来的缺陷），省去了仅用于缓存更新的额外模型前向计算，使不同视频块可在多GPU上并行占据不同去噪阶段，从而大幅加速少步自回归视频扩散生成。
en_tdlr: FlashForward accelerates few-step autoregressive video diffusion by directly reusing the in-flight KV cache already computed during denoising forwards (with clean anchors to compensate for the noisy history), eliminating cache-update-only forwards and enabling different chunks to occupy different denoising stages concurrently across GPUs.
